note: _in regione umbrae mortis_ (Clementina, Weber/Gryson) _–_ in the land of the shadow of death. According to Gryson, Jerome most likely wrote _umbramortis_ (one word, reflecting the underlying Hebrew _tsalmawet_), as he did in Jer 13:16 (Benedictine edition); this would have to be rendered as “in the land Deathshadow.” – Roger Gryson: Barachie et la prophétisse. _Revue biblique_ 96.3 (1989) 321–337, at pp. 335–336.
